ja: 日経平均、一時1300円近く上がって6万9600円台まで行ったのに、7万円が見えたとたん売られて405円高で終わっちゃった…😳 しかも今日のSQ値は6万9702円で、その値段一度もついてない「幻のSQ」なんだって。そんなことある? #日本株
en: The Nikkei was up almost 1,300 yen and touched 69,600 today, then everyone took profits the second 70,000 came into view — closed just +405 😳 also today's SQ settlement print was 69,702, a level the index never actually traded at. they literally call it a phantom SQ #JapanStocks
